object.description: Read a document whose folder DOC holds DOC.xml with root element document and id DOC. Read a folder holding no manifest. Read folder WRONG whose WRONG.xml has id DIFFERENT. Copy a document folder that was read to OTHER, rename its manifest OTHER.xml, and read the copy. Read a manifest with id X as stored at a version under folder DOC. Create an object and look at the manifest's root element. Expected: the first reads as document DOC; the folder without a manifest is an error saying the manifest wasn't found; each id that differs from its folder's name is a load error saying so; the root element is document.
